headline: Foreign Tourists Spent 14 Trillion Won in Korea; Foreign Visitors Surpass 15 Million Through August
summary: Foreign visitors to South Korea exceeded 15 million through August, a pace two months faster than last year. Card spending by foreign tourists reached 14 trillion won over the same period.
why: Tourism spending is a services export that supports hotels, retail and transport, and it feeds into South Korea's current account and consumer demand.
